scientific_integrity: Proof is analytic for all even N. The finite NumPy verifier is a cross-check, not an infinite proof. Prior Catalan multiplicity and general DFS projector conditions are explicitly credited.
scientific_limitations: Exact for the whole even-qubit collective singlet sector with only static real pairwise ZZ couplings, on-site transverse X fields and collective raising/lowering jump operators. No claims about generic local baths, odd-qubit dark sectors, broad Hamiltonians, individual-singlet sufficiency, or novelty certification.
title: Complete weighted-Ising criterion for exact protection of every collective spin singlet
